senses.gloss:
ऋतुः [ऋ-तु-किच्च Uṇ. 1. 71]
—1 A season, period of the year, commonly reckoned to be six; शिशिरश्च
 वसन्तश्च ग्रीष्मो वर्षाः शरद्धिमः; sometimes only five; शिशिर
 and हिम or हेमन्त being counted together; cf. पञ्चर्तवो हेमन्तशिशिरयोः
 समासेन Ait. Br. वसन्तश्चैत्रवैशाखौ ज्येष्ठाषाढौ च ग्रीष्मकौ । वर्षा
 श्रावणभाद्राभ्यां शरदश्विनकार्तिकौ ॥ मार्गपौषौ च हेमन्तः शिशिरो माघफाल्गुनौ ॥
 गोरक्षसंहिता.
—2 An epoch, a period, any fixed or appointed time.
—3 Menstruation, courses, menstrual discharge.
—4 A period favourable for conception; वरमृतुषु नैवाभिगमनम् Pt. 1;
 ऋतुः स्वाभाविकः स्त्रीणां रात्रयः षोडश स्मृताः Ms. 3. 46, 9. 70; Y. 1. 11, 79.
—5 Any fit season or right time.
—6 Fixed order or rule; द्वा यन्तारा भवतस्तथ ऋतुः Rv. 1. 162. 19.
—7 Light, splendour.
—8 A month.
—9 N. of Viṣṇu.
—10 A symbolical expression for the number ‘six’.
—11 A kind of collyrium.
.━{@Comp.@}: ऋत्वन्तः, ऋतुकालः, ऋतुसमयः, ऋतुवेला, ऋतुगणः, ऋतुगामिन्, ऋतुग्रहः, ऋतुचर्या, ऋतुजुष्, ऋतुधामन्, ऋतुपतिः, ऋतुपर्णः, ऋतुपर्यायः, ऋतुवृत्तिः, ऋतुपशुः, ऋतुपाः, ऋतुपात्रम्, ऋतुप्राप्त, ऋतुप्रैषः, ऋतुमुखम्, ऋतुयाजः, ऋतुराजः, ऋतुलिङ्गम्, ऋतुलोका, ऋतुष्ठा, ऋतुसंहारः, ऋतुसन्धिः, ऋतुसात्म्यम्, ऋतुस्तोमः, ऋतुस्नाता, ऋतुस्नानम्

ऋतुः + -कालः, -समयः, -वेला
—1 the time of menstruation, time favourable for conception, i. e. 16
 nights from menstrual discharge; see ऋतु above.
—2 the duration of a season.

ऋतुः + -कालः, -समयः, -वेला
—1 the time of menstruation, time favourable for conception, i. e. 16
 nights from menstrual discharge; see ऋतु above.
—2 the duration of a season.

ऋतुः + -कालः, -समयः, -वेला
—1 the time of menstruation, time favourable for conception, i. e. 16
 nights from menstrual discharge; see ऋतु above.
—2 the duration of a season.
ऋतुः + -गणः the seasons taken collectively.

ऋतुः + -गामिन् a. having intercourse with a wife (at the time fit
 for conception, i. e. after the period of menstruation).

ऋतुः + -ग्रहः a libation offered to the seasons,
[]
 a kind of sacrifice.

ऋतुः + -चर्या f. seasonal proceeding; उथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि ऋतुचर्यास्तु
 वाजिनाम् Bhojaʼs Śālihotra 92.
ऋतुः + -जुष् f. A woman enjoying intercourse at the time fit for procreation; Ks.
ऋतुः + -धामन् m. N. of Viṣṇu.

ऋतुः + -पतिः
—1 the lord of seasons, i. e. the spring.
—2 N. of Agni; Rv. 10. 2. 1. —3 N. of other deities; Av. 3. 10. 9.

ऋतुः + -पर्णः N. of a king of Ayodhyā; son of Ayutāyu, a descendant
 of Ikṣvāku. [Nala, king of Niṣadha, entered into his service after
 he had lost his kingdom and suffered very great adversity. He was ‘profoundly skilled in dice’
; and he exchanged with Nala this skill for his skill
 in horsemanship; and by virtue of it the king succeeded in taking Nala
 to Kuṇḍinapura before Damayantī had put into execution her resolve of
 taking a second husband].
ऋतुः + -पर्यायः, -वृत्तिः the revolution of the seasons; cf. Ms. 1. 29.
ऋतुः + -पर्यायः, -वृत्तिः the revolution of the seasons; cf. Ms. 1. 29.
ऋतुः + -पशुः An animal to be sacrificed at a particular season.
ऋतुः + -पाः m. N. of Indra.
ऋतुः + -पात्रम् the cup in which the libation is offered.
ऋतुः + -प्राप्त a. fertile, fruitful.

ऋतुः + -प्रैषः N. of particular invocations spoken before the sacrifice
 to the seasons. Ait. Br. 5. 9. 3, 4.
ऋतुः + -मुखम् the beginning or first day of a season.
ऋतुः + -याजः a sacrifice offered to the seasons.
ऋतुः + -राजः the spring.

ऋतुः + -लिङ्गम्
—1 a characteristic or sign of the season (as the blossom of the mango
 tree in spring); यथर्तुलिङ्गान्यृतवः स्वयमेवर्तुपर्यये Ms. 1. 30.
—2 a symptom of menstruation.
ऋतुः + -लोका f. N. of particular bricks; Śat. Br. 10.

ऋतुः + -ष्ठा
(-स्था) a. fixed at the proper seasons; Vāj. 17. 3.

ऋतुः + -संहारः ‘collection of the seasons’, N. of Kālidāsaʼs work
 on the six seasons.

ऋतुः + -सन्धिः
—1 the junction of two seasons.
—2 the last day in the bright fortnight (पौर्णमासी) and in the dark
 one (दर्श).
ऋतुः + -सात्म्यम् diet &c. suited to the season.
ऋतुः + -स्तोमः a kind of sacrifice.

ऋतुः + -स्नाता a woman who has bathed after menstruation and who is, therefore,
 fit for sexual intercourse; धर्मलोपभयाद्राज्ञीमृतुस्नातामिमां स्मरन् R. 1. 76.
ऋतुः + -स्नानम् bathing after menstruation.

ऋतुमत् a. Ved.
—1 Coming regularly; अग्निष्वात्तानृतुमतो हवामहे Vāj. 19. 61.
—2 Enjoying the seasons.

ऋतुमत् + .{@-ती@}
—1 A woman during her courses.
—2 A girl at the age of puberty, marriagable girl; काममामरणात्तिष्ठेद्
 गृहे कन्यर्तुमत्यपि Ms. 9. 89 ff.

ऋतुया ind.
—1 In order, duly.
—2 Precisely, exactly.
—3 At the right or fixed time.
